description: This file contains build script utilities for generating a build stamp. It defines functions to resolve the current Git commit hash and write a build stamp file with build timestamp and Git hash.

methods.name: resolveGitHead
methods.description: Resolves the current Git HEAD commit hash by executing 'git rev-parse HEAD' in the given directory.

methods.name: writeBuildStamp
methods.description: Creates a build stamp file containing the current timestamp and Git HEAD hash within the 'dist' directory.
